# runzero_account_sites (Data Source)

Fetches all sites across the RunZero account.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `search` (String) Optional search query to filter sites.

### Read-Only

- `sites` (Attributes List) List of sites across all organizations. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--sites))

<a id="nestedatt--sites"></a>
### Nested Schema for `sites`

Read-Only:

- `created_at` (Number) Unix timestamp when the site was created.
- `description` (String) Description of the site.
- `excludes` (String) Excluded scan targets.
- `id` (String) The UUID of the site.
- `name` (String) The name of the site.
- `scope` (String) The scan scope for this site.
- `updated_at` (Number) Unix timestamp when the site was last updated.
